name: No Target Dummy Text
creator: moga
description:
### Overview:

* Disables the DPS font below target dummies. This only edits any text specific to a dummy's DPS tracker, so it wont fuck over fonts elsewhere in the game. This is in a (hopefully) obscure bin, i.e., it doesn't write `floatingtext` and hopefully wont break soon.
* Works with my [Invisible Target Dummy](https://runeforge.dev/mods/b1e00958-3fbd-4f53-ab5d-9f0838a783e0) mod.
* Works with the [Old Damage Numbers](https://runeforge.dev/mods/72cdbd60-9782-4e81-93fa-3e9608eb3e61) mod.
* Works with my [Old Health Bars](https://runeforge.dev/mods/b7f4cc6d-0db5-4bd4-89e2-d08b7c819d68) mod.
* Will work with my Old Pings mod when I post it.
